rationale: Neither write-up has hallucinations or rule violations, and both cover the single catalog topic. Y has one unsupported conflation: it puts Belshazzar's Temple-vessel party and his calculation (seg 47) onto Achashverosh. Y also has a flow break (the isolated three-day fast sentence), one padding sentence, and a garbled term copied into the Yiddish. X has 0 of each. In Y's favor, it covers the 127-provinces numerology that X skips. The Yiddish is comparably translation-driven on both sides, so the tier-2/3 counts give X a slight edge.
